mapper.select: SELECT user_id,emp_id, username,password, role_name,avatar,last_login_time FROM v_sys_user_role_info WHERE username =#{username}

SELECT su.user_id as userId, su.emp_id as empId, su.username, su.avatar, su.last_login_time as lastLoginTime, sr.role_name as roleName FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON su.user_id = sur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE su.user_id = #{userId}
